api_doc_gaps.detail: Plan prose described Search as GET with query params; build-create-controller A.6.6 requires POST /search with @RequestBody for dynamic filter criteria. No derivation/rationale was given in the plan for deviating from the skill's hard rule.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: Resolved before dispatch, per explicit human confirmation: implemented as POST /api/v1/common/configurations/search per the skill. Plan prose treated as stale/non-binding on this point.

api_doc_gaps.detail: The module's artifacts publish ERR-0002 APP_CONFIGURATION_FIELDS_REQUIRED, but the code is structurally unreachable over HTTP. ConfigurationCreateRequest.configValue carries @NotBlank, so Spring bean validation refuses the request at the controller boundary and GlobalExceptionHandler.handleValidation answers 400 / VALIDATION_ERROR with fieldErrors[{field: configValue}] before AppConfigurationDomain.create() — the only throw site of ERR-0002 — is entered. Verified against the running app 2026-09-12: POST with configKey only returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming configValue. The rule itself IS enforced; only the published code is unobservable. TC-BE-CU-004 was corrected to assert the real contract (400, VALIDATION_ERROR, fieldErrors naming configValue), which still proves the rule and the field it guards.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — human decision required: either (a) relax the bean validation on ConfigurationCreateRequest.configValue so the domain rule owns the refusal and ERR-0002 becomes reachable (losing handleValidation's per-field detail and its report-all-failures-at-once behaviour), or (b) strike ERR-0002 from CU's error catalog and state in the artifacts that RULE-CU-002 is enforced structurally at the DTO layer. No error-catalog file was edited by this entry.

api_doc_gaps.detail: The module's artifacts publish ERR-0003 APP_CONFIGURATION_KEY_IMMUTABLE and TC-BE-CU-006 expected 422, but the code has no throw site at all — CuErrorCodes itself documents it as 'registered for catalog completeness; unused by any throw site because enforcement is structural — configKey is excluded from ConfigurationUpdateRequest at the DTO layer'. Verified 2026-09-12: ConfigurationUpdateRequest declares only configValue, notes and isActive, so a configKey property in the update body is an unknown JSON field, ignored, and 200 is correct REST behaviour; the invariant holds (the old key still resolves, the attempted new key 404s). TC-BE-CU-006 was corrected to assert that invariant — accepted AND the key did not change — as its primary claim.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — human decision required: either (a) add configKey to ConfigurationUpdateRequest with a runtime guard so RULE-CU-003 owns an observable refusal and ERR-0003 becomes reachable, or (b) strike ERR-0003 from CU's error catalog and record in the artifacts that RULE-CU-003 is enforced structurally by the DTO's shape. No error-catalog file was edited by this entry.
